capabilities: View and edit marimo .py notebooks in a dedicated tab with edit or run mode
Embed notebooks inline in notes via ```marimo blocks
Start and stop a local, token-authenticated marimo server automatically
Install or upgrade marimo with a one-click pip install
Configure Python interpreter and marimo executable paths
extras: Desktop only: it relies on Node's child_process and Electron's <webview> tag, so it does not run on Obsidian Mobile. Installation from source or via BRAT. Obsidian 1.5.7+ required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open, edit, or run marimo Python notebooks, which normally require running marimo's editor as a separate app.

relations.evidence: a one-click pip install marimo (modeled after the JupyMD plugin)

summary: Runs a local marimo server and embeds its UI in a webview to view and edit marimo Python notebooks (.py) in tabs and inline embeds.
